mapper.sql: account.id, account.email, account.role, account.email_verified_at, account.password_hash IS NOT NULL AS has_password, account.suspended_at, account.created_at, account.last_login_at, company.company_name, company.business_number, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(identity.provider ORDER BY identity.provider SEPARATOR ',') FROM account_oauth_identity identity WHERE identity.account_id = account.id ) AS oauth_providers
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM account LEFT JOIN company ON company.account_id = account.id
ORDER BY account.created_at ASC, account.id ASC
ORDER BY account.last_login_at IS NULL, account.last_login_at DESC, account.id DESC
ORDER BY account.created_at DESC, account.id DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account LEFT JOIN company ON company.account_id = account.id

SELECT
FROM account LEFT JOIN company ON company.account_id = account.id WHERE account.id = #{id} AND account.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(company.id IS NOT NULL), 0) AS company_registered, COALESCE(SUM(EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM account_oauth_identity identity WHERE identity.account_id = account.id )), 0) AS social_linked, COALESCE(SUM(account.suspended_at IS NOT NULL), 0) AS suspended, COALESCE(SUM(account.role = 'ADMIN'), 0) AS admins, COALESCE(SUM(account.created_at >= #{joinedSince}), 0) AS joined_recently FROM account LEFT JOIN company ON company.account_id = account.id WHERE account.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT company.company_name, company.business_number, company.region, company.industry, company.founded_year FROM company WHERE company.account_id = #{accountId}

SELECT action.id, action.target_account_id, action.admin_account_id, action.action, action.reason, action.created_at, admin.email AS admin_email FROM account_admin_action action JOIN account admin ON admin.id = action.admin_account_id WHERE action.target_account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY action.created_at DESC, action.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT account.id, account.role, account.suspended_at FROM account WHERE account.id = #{id} AND account.deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_admin_action ( target_account_id, admin_account_id, action, reason, created_at ) VALUES ( #{targetAccountId}, #{adminAccountId}, #{action}, #{reason}, #{createdAt} )
